text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, cheap.
Meat can be frozen, so maybe stocking up is an option...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The special sale at this shop over here is super cheap too.
They only announced it on the store's website,
so the competition should be low~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, which way should I go around...
Maybe I should decide what dish I want to make first.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, since the curry the other day was
such a hit, prioritizing those ingredients—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, it's decided!
Now our shopping is all sorted out!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa, is it this late already?!
Uh-oh~, I got way too carried away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Ines Fujin seems to have been
staying up rather late...
